verdict.rationale: TrueLayer is a payments and open-banking API platform, not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product category. The evidence shows TrueLayer publishes its own MCP server for Claude to connect to. That is the server role, belongs to a separate story, and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
